name: @smarthire/dashboard
_comment_lint: HARDENED 2026-09-06: was `next lint`, which Next 16 removed — so this script had been exiting non-zero on every invocation, and nothing invoked it. eslint.config.mjs was scaffolded here from the start but eslint itself was never a dependency; it and eslint-config-next are root devDependencies now, and the rules live in @smarthire/config. Run from the repo root with `npm run lint`.
_comment_build: KEY-SHAPE 2026-09-06: the build is wrapped, not plain `next build`. The env pass fails before a bundle exists and names the offending variable; the bundle pass then scans the emitted client chunks, which is the half that still holds when a secret arrives under a variable name nobody predicted. Both are needed - see the header of scripts/assert-no-public-secrets.mjs for the measurement showing why the runtime assert in @smarthire/data/public-key is not enough on its own.

scripts.build: node ../../scripts/assert-no-public-secrets.mjs env && next build && node ../../scripts/assert-no-public-secrets.mjs bundle .next/static
